sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(entity, row_key));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_tombstones" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(entity, doc_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TRIGGER sync_projects_insert AFTER INSERT ON projects WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_meta WHERE "key" = 'applying') BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key, changed_at) VALUES ('projects', NEW.uuid, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) ON CONFLICT (entity, row_key) DO UPDATE SET changed_at = excluded.changed_at;END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_projects_update AFTER UPDATE ON projects WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_meta WHERE "key" = 'applying') BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (entity, row_key, changed_at) VALUES ('projects', NEW.uuid, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) ON CONFLICT (entity, row_key) DO UPDATE SET changed_at = excluded.changed_at;END
